title: Adaptive hotspot tenant quota & sparse metric emitter
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Reduce ingestion cost and cardinality noise by implementing an adaptive, per-tenant hotspot detection and sparse metric emitter that throttles or synthesizes metrics at source. The emitter should emit full-resolution metrics for steady-state traffic and switch to sparse-mode for tenant hotspots (sudden bursty traffic or pathological cardinality growth). It must integrate with our OTLP sidecar and Prometheus export pipeline, preserve causal trace linkage, and expose controls for SLA windows and temporary quota overrides.
acceptance_criteria: Hotspot detector identifies tenants with >3x baseline distinct label growth in a 5m sliding window
Sparse emitter reduces cardinality by >70% for identified hotspots while preserving SLO-relevant quantiles within 5% error
End-to-end trace->metric correlation preserved: emitted sparse metrics include stable trace anchors for sampling and root-cause analysis
Configurable per-tenant policy: blocklist labels, whitelist routes, soft quota with notification, and emergency bypass
Automated rollout via canary on small subset of tenants and telemetry to measure cost delta and debugging success
implementation_notes: We will implement the detector as a windowed cardinality sketch (HyperLogLog/Theta) augmented with rate estimates to detect bursts vs steady high-cardinality tenants.
Sparse emitter has two modes: sampling-based (emit 1/n traces per unique label set) and synthesis-based (emit aggregated pseudo-buckets with histogram summaries). Choose mode per-tenant via policy.
Keep OTLP span/trace identifiers in metric labels: add trace_id and request_sample_id anchors where available to keep root-cause traces linkable even after aggregation.
Prometheus remote_write adapter will receive synthetic/aggregated series with metadata flags (sparse_mode=true) so downstream rollups and dashboards can interpret them.
To avoid step-changes in SLOs, provide a mirrored stream of full-resolution metrics to a short-lived hot-store (48h) for on-demand debug access if needed; this store is retention-gated and expensive.

Backpressure/latency: emitter must operate asynchronously in sidecar to avoid adding >5ms p95 to request lifecycle. Use bounded queue and drop-oldest policy with observability counters for dropped events.
tradeoffs: Accuracy vs cost: aggressive aggregation reduces cost but can obscure rare error signals; mitigate with adaptive thresholds and emergency bypass.
Complexity: adding causal anchors increases label cardinality; we use stable short anchors (hash prefixes) to reduce cardinality while preserving traceability.
Operational burden: hot-store increases cost and requires retention management; we limit usage to support tickets flagged by SRE/Customer Success.

Proto sparse-emitter lib as OTLP filter plugin (ENG-765432-b): unit tests + perf harness
Prometheus adapter flagging and metadata contract (ENG-765432-c): update schema + integration tests
Canary rollout orchestration (ENG-765432-d): infra changes + alerting for cost/accuracy regressions
Dashboarding and alerting (ENG-765432-e): grafana panels for cost delta, cardinality delta, and debug drilldowns
current_progress: 2025-01-12: Kickoff meeting with Observability, SRE, and Product to align goals and SLAs
2025-01-20: Initial design doc posted (see design_links). Decided on HLL + rate heuristics as primary detector.
2025-01-28: Prototype detector implemented in telemetry-proxy sidecar. Local benchmarks show <2ms extra p95 and 4x lower emitted series on synthetic hotspot traffic.
2025-02-02: Integration spike adding trace anchors to aggregated metrics. Verified linking works end-to-end in staging dashboards.
2025-02-09: Security review flagged the hot-store retention policy; SSO+audit logging required for access. Added to tasks.
risks: False negatives: detector may miss slow-growing cardinality increases leading to unexpected cost spikes
User debugging friction: aggregated metrics might not contain enough signal for root-cause without hot-store access
Regulatory: certain customers may forbid aggregation that removes per-request identifiers; must support bypass for Private/VPC customers
mitigations: Expose a manual override API for customer success to enable hot-store for a tenant for a limited window
Tune detector thresholds with historical tenant traces in staging and run backtests across 90 days of metric history
Document policies and provide clear SLO contract changes; add an opt-out label for tenants with compliance needs
notes_for_release: Feature gated behind org-level toggle; default off for existing tenants. Canary to 1% tenant sample for first 2 weeks, monitor cost and SLO deltas; keep hot-store enabled for debugging on request.
